INTERVIEW 049-104-6 — Dr. Ellery, E.

Dr. Ellery: You keep using the word 'cure'. Your patients are dead.

SCP-049: They are *cleansed*. Death is incidental — a side effect of an aggressive treatment for an aggressive disease. You have seen the Pestilence yourself, Doctor. You have it now. It is why I agreed to speak with you.

Dr. Ellery: I'm perfectly healthy.

SCP-049: [Pause.] Of course. My mistake.
[Dr. Ellery terminated the interview at this point. Dr. Ellery reported to the infirmary with a mild fever forty minutes later and was placed under observation.]
[Observation ended at 03:47 when power failed. Dr. Ellery's current whereabouts: unknown. If encountered, do not approach: the Doctor considers treated patients his property, and he checks on them.]
